name: Sioux Falls

neighborhoods.name: Cathedral District
neighborhoods.homes: historic houses, some split into apartments

neighborhoods.name: All Saints
neighborhoods.homes: older houses and small apartment buildings

housing: Sioux Falls renters live mostly in apartment complexes and single-family homes, with older houses near downtown.

tenantHelp.name: East River Legal Services
tenantHelp.what: free legal help and an eviction prevention hotline

climate: Test the furnace, check windows and doors for drafts and ask who clears snow; winters are long and very cold.
fact: The Big Sioux River runs through the city, so ask about flooding if the home is near it.
